name: Nitou Harumi
source:
A really serious committee chairman type of girl. She strives to make everyone have a disciplined life. She's in charge of cooking, and does her best with few ingredients.

Since she's very knowledgable on plants, she fetches vegetables from fields as well as edible wild plants from the mountains. She tries to take on the role of mediator for the group, but has problems with what to say to everyone.
